resources.string: Ringomote acts as a Bluetooth remote for your Apple TV. To do that, it needs permission to connect to and be found by nearby devices. Nothing leaves your phone except the button presses sent to your Apple TV.
Permission was not granted. If the system no longer asks, allow “Nearby devices” in the app settings.
This phone cannot act as a Bluetooth input device, so it cannot control an Apple TV.
Ringomote could not register as a Bluetooth remote. Another app may be using the Bluetooth input device. Close that app and try again.
Not connected. Pair from the Apple TV, or connect to a paired device below.
On the Apple TV, open Settings > Remotes and Devices > Bluetooth.
This phone has no screen for that Bluetooth setting.
Use your phone as a remote for Apple TV, compatible with the Siri Remote (1st generation).
Ringomote has no internet permission and collects no data. Button presses go only to your Apple TV, directly over Bluetooth. The app stores one setting on your phone: whether it has connected before.
